strings.long_src: Board Tricycle

strings.en_src: We're in the Tricycle. Where shall￥we go?

strings.en: Хотя куда мы едем, и так ясно.
strings.en_src: Though we already know where we're￥headed.

strings.en: Это запасной трицикл, поэтому он не￥покрашен. Но ездит отлично.
strings.en_src: A spare tricycle, so unpainted, but￥it runs well enough.
strings.long_src: It's a spare Tricycle, so it hasn't￥been painted. It runs perfectly￥well.

strings.en_src: Take a good look. In 12 hours￥this vehicle's finished too.
strings.long_src: Take a good look. In twelve hours,￥we won't be able to use this vehicle￥either.
strings.long: Посмотри на него хорошенько. Через￥двенадцать часов и этой машиной уже￥не воспользоваться.

strings.en_src: This parking lot looks bleak now.
No car or soul but us...
strings.long_src: Ours is the only vehicle. We're the￥only ones here.
strings.long: Ни машин, ни людей - только мы.

strings.long_src: Investigate

strings.en_src: It seems sound.￥Nothing done to it.
strings.long_src: It looks safe. It hasn't been￥tampered with.
strings.long: Похоже, всё в порядке. Никто ничего￥не трогал.

strings.en: Не волнуйся. С ним всё нормально.
strings.long_src: Don't worry. Nothing is wrong with￥it.

strings.en: Движения нет. Здесь только ты и я.
strings.en_src: No movement detected. You and I are￥alone here.
I'll save our progress so far.

strings.long_src: Let's hurry to the church!
Church
Exit Tricycle

strings.en_src: Going in by ourselves is crazy.

strings.long_src: We've reached the church.
Go inside
Building

strings.en_src: An old church... rather like Saint￥Basil's.
strings.long_src: An old church. It looks a little￥like St. Basil's Cathedral.
strings.long: Старая церковь. Чем-то похожа на￥храм Василия Блаженного.

strings.en_src: They must have thought so, too.
Built after a Russian Orthodox￥church?￥Quite old.
strings.long_src: It may be modeled on a Russian￥Orthodox church. It looks very old.
strings.long: Возможно, она построена по образцу￥православного храма. Выглядит очень￥старой.

strings.long_src: Snow

strings.en: Похоже на снег, но это пыльца￥снежного кедра. Смотри не вдохни её.
strings.en_src: It looks like snow but is Snow￥Cedar. Take care not to breathe it.
strings.long_src: It looks like snow, but it's Snow￥Cedar pollen. Be careful not to￥breathe it in.

strings.en_src: Pollen, so far finer than snow.
strings.long_src: Since it's pollen, it's much finer￥than snow.
strings.long: Это пыльца, поэтому она гораздо￥мельче снега.

strings.long_src: We're surrounded by tall cedar￥trees.

strings.en_src: No homeless will come near this.
strings.long_src: Even the homeless would stay away￥from this.
Christmas lights would look nice￥here this time of year.
strings.long: В это время года здесь смотрелись бы￥рождественские гирлянды.

strings.en_src: You can't see this church￥except from above.
strings.long_src: The church seems to be visible only￥from above.

strings.en_src: Half a century old, but braced here￥and there.
strings.long_src: The building is half a century old,￥but some parts have been reinforced.
Where's the entrance?
At the front.

strings.en_src: The carving is eaten by acid rain.
strings.long_src: Acid rain has eaten away the￥carvings on the surface.

strings.en: Не верится, что их столько растёт в￥городе.
strings.en_src: Hard to believe it breeds so in the￥city.
strings.long_src: I can't believe so many are growing￥in the city.

strings.en: Сканер показывает, что под нами￥проходит тьюб-лайнер.
strings.en_src: My scan shows the Tube Liner runs￥beneath us.

strings.long_src: As I thought. This must be the￥place.
strings.long: Как я и думал. Это то самое место.

strings.en_src: Above ground there is nothing but￥this church.
strings.long_src: The church seems to be the only￥structure above ground.
strings.long: Похоже, кроме церкви, на поверхности￥ничего нет.

strings.long_src: Motion detector
Listen
All I can hear is the wind.
Are you running away, Gillian?

strings.en_src: So the videophone is no use here.
strings.long_src: As expected, the videophone won't￥work here.
strings.long: Как я и думал, видеофон здесь не￥работает.

strings.long_src: No significant movement detected.
What is this place?

strings.en_src: You think they pray? To what?

strings.en: Смотри. Впереди портрет. Они молятся￥этому человеку?
strings.en_src: See, a portrait hangs at the front.￥Do they pray to that man?
strings.long_src: Look. There's a portrait at the￥front. Do they pray to that man?
Go further in
Let's enter the room at the back.
Portrait

strings.en_src: Is this the creator the Snatchers￥speak of?
strings.long_src: Could this be the creator the￥Snatchers spoke of?
strings.long: Может, это и есть создатель, о￥котором говорили снатчеры?

strings.en_src: Wait. I'll compare the portrait with￥our data.
The frame ratios do match Randam's￥own data, but it's no photograph, so￥I can't be sure.
strings.long_src: The bone proportions and other￥features match Randam's, but it's a￥painting, so I can't be certain.
strings.long: Пропорции костей и другие черты￥совпадают с Рэндамом, но это￥картина, так что наверняка не скажу.

strings.long_src: That's too close to be a￥coincidence.

strings.en: А ведь и правда, похож на Рэндама￥Хаджайла.
strings.en_src: Come to think...￥it looks like Randam Hajile.
strings.long_src: Now that you mention it, he does￥look like Randam Hajile.
Chair
These must be seats for worshippers.

strings.en: Пыли на них нет. Похоже, ими часто￥пользуются.
strings.en_src: There's no dust on them. They seem￥to be used often.
The old USSR before its fall,￥rebuilt.
strings.long_src: It looks like a recreation of the￥Soviet Union before its collapse.
strings.long: Похоже, здесь воссоздан Советский￥Союз до распада.

strings.long_src: These don't look like church￥decorations.
The painting is labeled ＠赤Madnar, Our￥Creator＠白.
The one the Snatchers mentioned?
It appears to be a portrait of him.

strings.en: Судя по краскам и холсту, картину￥написали около полувека назад.
strings.en_src: Judging by the paint and canvas, it￥was painted about half a century￥ago.

strings.en: На поверхности много царапин. Может,￥это снатчеры?
strings.en_src: There are many scratches on the￥surface. Could they be from￥Snatchers?
Something very heavy stood on it.￥Quite worn.
strings.long_src: It must have held something very￥heavy. It's badly worn.
strings.long: На нём, видно, стояло что-то очень￥тяжёлое. Сильно изношен.

strings.en_src: Oddly tidy, with no human feel. Oh,￥a room lies beyond.
strings.long_src: It's so orderly it doesn't feel￥human. Oh, there's a room at the￥back.
strings.long: Тут так аккуратно, что не￥чувствуется человека. О, сзади есть￥комната.

strings.en_src: Not a speck of dust. It's too clean.

strings.en: Они что, все ушли на саммит?
strings.en_src: They... all out at the summit?
strings.long_src: Have they all gone to the summit?
What is this place?
Here they come!＠Ｃ
Can you handle them this time?＠Ｃ
Leave it to me!＠Ｃ
Are you sure you can handle them￥this time?＠Ｃ

strings.en_src: There's no doubt Snatchers are￥hiding here.

strings.en: Да. При такой охране это должна быть￥важная база.
strings.en_src: Aye, and that many of them.￥This must be a major base.
strings.long_src: Yeah. With that many guards, this￥must be an important base.
Let's proceed carefully.

strings.en_src: No energy readings. They're all￥inactive, in storage.

strings.long_src: Is this their storage facility?

strings.en: Их здесь сотни. Тянутся до самой￥стены.
strings.en_src: Hundreds, it seems.￥They stretch far back.
strings.long_src: There must be hundreds. They go all￥the way to the back.

strings.en: Но на завод это не похоже.
strings.en_src: But this doesn't look like a￥factory.
Ready? Let's move into the next￥room.

strings.en: Это эндоскелеты без искусственной￥кожи. Регулируемые пазы в каркасах￥сжаты до минимального размера.
strings.en_src: Endoskeletons, before the skin goes￥on. The frames are shrunk to least￥size at the slits.
strings.long_src: They're endoskeletons without￥artificial skin. The adjustable￥slots in their frames are contracted￥to the smallest size.

strings.en: Жертв они себе ещё не выбрали. Ждут￥своей очереди на подмену?
strings.en_src: They haven't chosen their victims￥yet. Waiting their turn to snatch￥someone?

strings.en: Кажется, вот-вот оживут. Если они￥двинутся разом, нам конец.
strings.en_src: They look ready to move.￥If this many moved at once, nothing￥could be done.
strings.long_src: They look ready to move at any￥moment. If they all started at once,￥we'd be helpless.

strings.en_src: Containers are stacked at the back.
strings.long_src: There are several containers stacked￥at the back.
There's nothing else here besides￥the containers.
There's writing on the floor.
It appears to be Russian.
Container
What about the size?

strings.en: Судя по объёму, в этих контейнерах￥сюда и привезли снатчеров.
strings.en_src: By its volume, this container surely￥carried the Snatchers here.
strings.long_src: Judging by their capacity, these￥containers must have brought the￥Snatchers here.

strings.en_src: All these endoskeletons arrived in￥those containers.

strings.en: Ничего не сломано. Им нужно только￥питание.
strings.en_src: Nothing is broken. They only need￥power to function.
They haven't had sex units installed￥yet.
Well kept, too. Maintained￥regularly, it seems.
strings.long_src: They're well preserved. They seem to￥receive regular maintenance.

strings.en: Ни оборудования, ни инструментов для￥обслуживания. Похоже, это просто￥склад снатчеров.
strings.en_src: No maintenance gear or tools to be￥seen. This is only a Snatcher store.
strings.long_src: I see no maintenance equipment or￥tools. This seems to be only a￥Snatcher storage facility.

strings.en: В отличие от часовни, здесь пыльно.
strings.en_src: Unlike the chapel, it's dusty in￥here.

strings.long_src: The ＠黄Siberian expedition＠白?

strings.en_src: So, from the neutral zone to this￥city...
strings.long_src: It looks like they came from the￥neutral zone to this city.
strings.long: Похоже, их привезли сюда из￥нейтральной зоны.

strings.long_src: The expedition teams appear to be￥transporting Snatchers.

strings.en: Значит, членов экспедиций подменяют￥- как тогда, когда спасли нас.
strings.en_src: So, as with us, the survey team is￥being snatched.
strings.long_src: So the team members are being￥snatched, just like when we were￥rescued.

strings.en_src: No doubt the Siberia team brought￥them. Soil peculiar to that region￥clings to it.
strings.long_src: The Siberian expedition definitely￥brought them here. They're covered￥in contaminated soil unique to that￥region.
strings.long: Их точно привезла Сибирская￥экспедиция. На них заражённая почва,￥какая бывает только там.

strings.en: Понятно. Сибирские экспедиции￥привозят снатчеров сюда на хранение.
strings.en_src: I see. The Siberian expeditions￥bring Snatchers here to be stored.

strings.en: Похоже на то. Здесь они ждут своей￥очереди, отключённые до поры.
strings.en_src: So it seems.￥Here they wait their turn to snatch,￥kept idle till then.
strings.long_src: Apparently. They wait here for their￥turn to snatch someone, kept￥inactive until then.

strings.en_src: Efficient. But where do they do the￥snatching?
Maybe we'll find out further in.

strings.en: Гиллиан, видно, как на снатчеров￥внутри наносят искусственную кожу.
strings.en_src: Gillian, within you can see the skin￥being laid on a Snatcher.
strings.long_src: Gillian, you can see artificial skin￥being applied to the Snatchers￥inside.

strings.en_src: A Snatcher in the snatch process is￥inside.
strings.long_src: There are Snatchers inside,￥undergoing the snatching process.
Snatch process

strings.en_src: Each cylinder has a computer￥terminal attached.

strings.en: Везде трубки и кабели. Смотри под￥ноги.
strings.en_src: Tubes and cables run everywhere.￥Watch your step.

strings.long_src: Door

strings.en_src: It's a small iron door with a knob.

strings.long_src: There must be a room beyond it.
Terminal

strings.en: Терминал, видимо, подключён к￥главному компьютеру. Похоже, он же￥управляет цилиндром.
strings.en_src: A terminal linked to the host￥computer. It runs the cylinders too,￥it seems.
strings.long_src: This terminal is probably connected￥to a host computer. It also seems to￥control the cylinder.

strings.en: На мониторе разные данные, схемы и￥фигуры.
strings.en_src: Data, charts and figures show on the￥monitor.
strings.long_src: The monitor displays various data,￥diagrams and shapes.

strings.en: Это цилиндр для выращивания￥искусственной кожи. Внутри погружён￥эндоскелет.
strings.en_src: A cylinder for culturing the skin.￥An endoskeleton soaks within.
strings.long_src: It's a cylinder for growing￥artificial skin. An endoskeleton is￥submerged inside.

strings.en: Он из толстого закалённого стекла.￥Так просто не разбить.
strings.en_src: It's made of thick, reinforced￥glass. It won't break easily.
Weak ultraviolet is cast from above.
strings.long_src: Weak ultraviolet light appears to￥shine down from above.
A serious operation. Queen Hospital￥had nothing like this.
strings.long: Серьёзное производство. В больнице￥"Куин" такого не было.

strings.en: Вся комната - чистая зона. В глубине￥дверь.
strings.en_src: The entire room is a clean room.￥There's a door at the back.
Fine gear. It surprises me they have￥so much.
strings.long_src: Remarkable equipment. I'm surprised￥they managed to assemble all this.
strings.long: Потрясающее оборудование. Не ожидал,￥что они столько соберут.

strings.en_src: Where do they get the money?

strings.en: Наверное, снатчеров внедрили и туда,￥откуда идут деньги.
strings.en_src: Snatchers are likely sent into the￥money sources too.
strings.long_src: They've probably placed Snatchers￥wherever they get their funding,￥too.

strings.en: Заперто, но с этой стороны можно￥открыть.
strings.en_src: It's locked, but we can open it from￥this side.
It seems it cannot be opened from￥within.
strings.long_src: It seems designed so it can't be￥opened from inside.
strings.long: Похоже, изнутри её не открыть - так￥задумано.

strings.en: Питание включено. Смотри! Тут данные￥о людях, которых собираются￥подменить.
strings.en_src: The power is on. Look! It contains￥data on the people they're going to￥snatch.

strings.en: Похоже, по этим данным воссоздают￥кожу жертв.
strings.en_src: From this data the skin is￥reproduced, it seems.
strings.long_src: They appear to use this data to￥reproduce the victims' skin.
All I can hear is bubbling from the￥cylinders.

strings.en_src: For now, only the steady sounds of￥the gear here.
strings.long_src: So far, all I hear is the steady￥sound of the equipment.

strings.en_src: This may be our last chance to save.
The signal won't hold. No sending￥from this area.
strings.long_src: The signal is unstable. We can't￥transmit from this area.
The Snow Cedar pollen concentration￥is extremely high.
We can't call for help, then.

strings.en: А как же тогда прошёл звонок Джейми?
strings.en_src: But how did Jamie's videophone reach￥us?
strings.long_src: Then how did Jamie's videophone call￥get through?
They probably used a large,￥high-powered transmitter.

strings.en: Из этого района ничего не передать.
strings.en_src: No sending at all from this area.
strings.long_src: We can't transmit anything from this￥area.

strings.en: Из-за пыльцы снежного кедра видеофон￥не работает.
strings.en_src: Snow Cedar is too dense for the￥videophone.
strings.long_src: The Snow Cedar pollen is too dense￥for the videophone to work.

strings.en_src: They don't let us pass easily.
strings.long_src: They're not letting us through￥easily.
The next door.
